items.teaser: The UK Security Service MI5 continues to regard Russia as the greatest threat to the United Kingdom.

items.teaser: Twelve Democratic and Republican senators have called on Donald Trump to reverse an agreement with Vladimir Putin allowing Russian-origin diesel to reach global markets. items.title: Three killed in Russian missile and drone attack on Kyiv overnight – photo

items.title: Pletenchuk: Russian naval drones pose threat to Black Sea countries

items.title: Russia detains Japanese journalist on espionage charges

items.title: Zelenskyy speaks to Canadian PM about Russian strike on Kyiv and upcoming engagement with US

items.title: Donetsk region to introduce extended curfew starting November 1

items.teaser: International lawyer Philippe Sands has revealed that his new book, forthcoming in 2030, will focus on prosecuting Russian aggression through the lens of Victoria Amelina's life and death.

items.title: Starlink in Flammen: Mutmaßliche Saboteure festgenommen
items.teaser: Im September brennt eine Starlink-Station in Polen.

items.title: Drone attack targets two merchant ships off Bulgaria's coast, with Ukrainians among casualties
items.teaser: Two merchant ships were struck by drones in separate incidents in the Black Sea near Bulgaria: one ship sank east of the village of Krapets, while the other survived the attack east of the city of Byala.

items.title: Zelenskyy: No warning from partners about Russian ballistic strike on Kyiv
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says Ukraine received no warning from its partners about Russia's five-missile ballistic strike on Kyiv on 12 October.

items.title: "American PR": Ukraine denies European involvement in "peace plan" leaked to Washington Post
items.teaser: Presidential adviser Dmytro Lytvyn has denied European involvement in a four-point peace proposal leaked to the press, calling it a single-sided American view.

items.title: The night Trump announced a diesel deal with Putin, drones knocked out more than half the tanks at a Russian fuel-export terminal
items.teaser: The Rostov-on-Don site, which loads oil products onto river and sea tankers, burned for two days and was still smoking on the third.

items.title: Bulgaria condemns Black Sea drone attacks as Russia's war in Ukraine spills over into Eastern Europe
items.teaser: Bulgaria has seen the second spate of drone attacks on merchant ships off its coast in the past week. Russia has been accused of repeatedly targeting civilian cargo ships in the area.

items.title: France, Poland, Spain, do not see agriculture as blocking further EU progress for Ukraine
items.teaser: Spain's European Affairs Minister Fernando Sampedro told the Kyiv Independent that "we really hope that in the case of Ukraine and Moldova we will be able to open all clusters as soon as possible."

items.title: Russia could export up to 3.5 million tonnes of diesel per month by year-end
items.teaser: Russia could increase diesel exports to 3-3.5 million tonnes per month by the end of 2026, Russian Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak has said.

items.title: Russische Angriffe auf Region Kyjiw: eine Person getötet und drei weitere verletzt, mehr als 20 Objekte beschädigt
items.teaser: Durch russische Angriffe in der Hauptstadtregion ist eine Person ums Leben gekommen. Drei weitere Personen wurden verletzt, teilt die regionale Militärverwaltung auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Russian drone debris fell and ablaze on Kyiv
items.teaser: Russian forces continued their drone attacks on the Ukrainian capital on Tuesday 13 October, with debris from a downed Russian UAV falling in one of Kyiv's districts.

items.title: Russian drone strikes educational building in Rivne, injures 20
items.teaser: Of the 20 injured, one is in critical condition, Oleksandr Koval, head of Rivne Oblast Military Administration, said on Oct. 13.

items.title: SOF cut off Russian infiltration route in Donetsk sector
items.teaser: Operators from the 3rd Regiment of the Special Operations Forces of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, the Sword Group, cut off one of the routes used by Russian troops to infiltrate the Donetsk sector.

items.title: Zelenskyy: Ukraine has not struck Russian oil refineries for two days, but Kremlin did not listen to Trump
items.teaser: Ukraine has refrained from striking Russian oil refineries and energy facilities for two days, but Russia continued attacks on Ukraine, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says.

items.title: Verfassungsschutz-Chef: Russland greift entkoppelt von Ukraine an
items.teaser: Was, wenn der Krieg in der Ukraine vorbei ist? Der Präsident des Verfassungsschutzes macht für ein solches Szenario wenig Hoffnung auf mehr Ruhe.

items.title: Russische Drohnen treffen Bildungseinrichtung in Riwne: es gibt mindestens 14 Verletzte
items.teaser: Russische Truppen haben eine Bildungseinrichtung im Zentrum der Stadt Riwne angegriffen. Mindestens 14 Menschen wurden verletzt, teilt die regionale Militärverwaltung auf Telegram mit.

items.title: US and Europe prepare peace plan to improve post-war state of Ukraine and Russia – The Washington Post
items.teaser: Washington and European allies are discussing a four-part peace framework trading territorial concessions for security guarantees and economic agreements.

items.title: Russian attacks kill at least 10, injure 74 across Ukraine over past day as Moscow hits homes, railway infrastructure
items.teaser: Overnight on Oct. 13, Russian forces launched five ballistic missiles, 108 Shahed-type attack drones, including 74 jet-powered versions, as well as Gerbera and Parodiya decoy drones, and nine Banderol missiles, Ukraine's Air Force said.

items.title: Spox Ihnat: Russia deploys about 200 jet-powered drones per day
items.teaser: Russian troops may be deploying about 200 jet-powered drones per day to carry out attacks on Ukraine.

items.title: Schwarzes Meer: Erneut Frachter vor bulgarischer Küste gesunken
items.teaser: Vor Bulgariens Küste sind wieder Handelsschiffe von Drohnen getroffen worden. Bei dem Angriff sank ein Frachter, mehrere Seeleute werden vermisst. Die bulgarische Regierung verdächtigt Russland und schaltet die NATO ein.

items.title: USA-News aktuell: ICE-Wagen erfasst Mann – Staatsanwalt prüft Vorsatz
items.teaser: Der geplante Import russischen Diesels in die USA stößt weltweit auf harsche Kritik. Ein Einsatz von ICE-Agenten hatte schwere Folgen. Alle Entwicklungen im Newsblog.

items.title: International Criminal Court: Statement by the High Representative on behalf of the EU following the announcement of US sanctions
items.teaser: The EU issued a statement reaffirming its full support for the ICC’s independence and its role in ensuring accountability for the most serious international crimes. EU regrets US sanctions against the Court, and calls for their reversal through diplomacy.

items.title: Festnahme im Zusammenhang mit Starlink-Anschlag in Polen
“We don’t need to hit the entire plant”—Ukraine’s drones go for refinery parts sanctions make hard to repair
items.teaser: Of 54 strikes The Washington Post examined, more than half appear to have damaged the units that start turning crude into fuel.

items.title: Zwei Schiffe vor Bulgarien erneut von Drohnen getroffen: ukrainisce Besatzungsmitglieder verletzt
items.teaser: Bei einem Drohnenangriff im Schwarzen Meer vor der bulgarischen Küste sind zwei Schiffe getroffen worden. Eines ist östlich von Krapets gesunken, schreibt Bulgariens Ministerpräsident Rumen Radew bei Facebook, wie das Nachrichtenportal Novinite berichtet.

items.title: Spox Ihnat explains why explosions sometimes occur before air raid sirens sound
items.teaser: Information about missile launches sometimes arrives late, and explosions may be heard even before an air raid alert is issued.

items.title: Ukraine hits Iskander-M repair base and radar station in Russia, along with other Russian targets
items.teaser: Units from Ukraine's defence forces struck a number of Russian military targets on 12 October and on the night of 12-13 October.

items.title: Ukraine’s swimming robot can tow 10 tons, its maker says. Hook up a gun, and the shells ride aboard
items.teaser: It has already swum across the Desna River, its team says, and Ukraine’s Defense Ministry cleared it for use in 2025.

items.title: Death toll from strike on Kharkiv residential building rises to four
items.teaser: Kharkiv Mayor Ihor Terekhov has confirmed the death toll reached four as search and rescue teams cleared debris from a destroyed residential building.

items.title: Generalstab meldet 202 Gefechte an der Front in den vergangenen 24 Stunden, die meisten davon - bei Pokrowsk
items.teaser: In den vergangenen 24 Stunden haben entlang der Front 202 Zusammenstöße zwischen den ukrainischen und russischen Streitkräften stattgefunden, teilt der ukrainische Generalstab auf Facebook mit.

items.title: Ukrainians injured in Russian attack on vessels near Bulgaria – Ukrainian foreign minister
items.teaser: Ukrainian and Azerbaijani citizens were injured in a Russian attack on merchant vessels near Bulgaria's territorial waters, Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha has said.

items.title: Russian attack on warehouse in Zaporizhzhia injures one person
items.teaser: Russian troops struck a warehouse in Zaporizhzhia.

items.title: 'Absolutely unacceptable' — Commercial vessel hit by drones near Bulgaria's Black Sea coast, says Prime Minister Radev
items.teaser: Bulgarian Prime Minister Rumen Radev called the attacks "absolutely unacceptable" and said Bulgaria had informed its permanent representatives to NATO and the European Union.

items.title: Instrument für Terroristen?: Top-Republikaner warnt vor öffentlicher Erschießung
items.teaser: Pete Hegseth will die Erschießung des Terroristen Nidal Hasan per Livestream übertragen lassen. Dafür bekommt er nicht nur von den Demokraten Gegenwind. Auch der Sprecher des Repräsentantenhauses hält das für einen Schritt mit womöglich gravierenden Folgen.

items.title: Drone attack targets industrial facilities in Russia's Stavropol Krai
items.teaser: Russia reported a drone attack on the urban-type settlement of Solnechnodolsk in the Stavropol Krai, where industrial facilities were targeted.

items.title: Vier Tote und über fünfzig Verletzte in der Region Charkiw durch russische Angriffe
items.teaser: In den letzten 24 Stunden standen Charkiw und 16 weitere Ortschaften der Region unter russischem Beschuss. Vier Menschen wurden getötet und 51 weitere verletzt, darunter vier Kinder, teilt der Leiter der regionalen Militärverwaltung, Oleh Synehubow, auf Facebook mit.

items.title: Russian drone strikes educational institution in central Rivne, leaving people injured
items.teaser: A Russian drone struck a building at an educational institution in central Rivne on 13 October, injuring people and causing significant damage to the building.

items.title: European commissioner outlines three key directions for EU enlargement preparation
items.teaser: The European Union must prepare to accept new members across three main directions: strengthening safeguards against backsliding on democratic norms, enabling more flexible decision-making and expanding gradual integration for candidate states prior to full membership.

items.title: Russian strike collapses a Kharkiv apartment stairwell and kills three, days after the US waived sanctions on Russia’s diesel
items.teaser: Rescuers dug through the night to reach the people buried in the four-story building, while the White House still wants Kyiv to stop striking Russian refineries.

items.title: Israel receives samples of Russian jet-powered drones from Ukraine for study
items.teaser: Israel has received samples of Russian Geran-5 jet-powered drones from Ukraine to analyse emerging UAV technologies and enhance laser interception systems.

items.title: US envoys say "diesel deal" is attempt to coax Russia into negotiations – Reuters
items.teaser: Reuters reports US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner urged Ukraine to halt refinery strikes, framing the diesel deal as leverage for peace negotiations.

items.title: Ukraine’s largest steelworks begins cold shutdown after extensive damage from Russian strikes, saying safe operation is impossible while war continues
items.teaser: The plant will spend two months shutting down safely before mothballing its industrial assets, with any restart dependent on conditions after the war.

items.title: Former commander-in-chief Syrskyi explains why he sent troops to Kursk operation instead of defending Pokrovsk
items.teaser: Oleksandr Syrskyi, former commander-in-chief of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, considers the Kursk operation a successful manoeuvre and says that Russia had concentrated a force of nearly 100,000 troops near Pokrovsk at the time, meaning that redeploying Ukrainian units there would not have changed the situation.

items.title: Russian attacks on Kharkiv region leave four killed, more than 50 injured over past day
items.teaser: Kharkiv and 16 other settlements in the Kharkiv region came under Russian attack over the past day, leaving four people dead and 51 injured, including four children.

items.title: Generalstab: 1540 russische Soldaten in den vergangenen 24 Stunden außer Gefecht gesetzt
items.teaser: Die Zahl der getöteten oder verletzten russischen Soldaten ist seit dem 24. Februar 2022 auf 1. 555. 700 gestiegen. Allein innerhalb von 24 Stunden beträgt die Zahl der Verluste 1540.

items.title: Trotz Sanktion: Moskau liefert Energie in EU für Milliarden
items.teaser: EU-Sanktionen haben den Energiehandel mit Russland nicht beendet. Seit Beginn des Ukraine-Kriegs lieferte Moskau weiterhin Öl und Gas an EU-Staaten, so Vizeregierungschef Nowak.

items.title: Drone debris falls on private house in Kyiv’s Darnytskyi district, woman injured
items.teaser: Debris from a Russian drone fell on the grounds of a private residential property in Kyiv’s Darnytskyi district, injuring a woman.

items.title: Bulgaria to summon Russian ambassador over drone attacks on merchant vessels
items.teaser: Prime Minister Rumen Radev has called drone strikes on commercial shipping near Bulgarian waters unacceptable, seeking explanations from Moscow's ambassador.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,555,700 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 1,390 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: Versuchter Anschlag in Fairford: Burnham sieht Teheran als Drahtzieher hinter Vorfall nahe Militärbasis
items.teaser: Mehrere Männer stehen unter Verdacht, einen Terroranschlag auf einen Militärstützpunkt in Großbritannien geplant zu haben. US-Außenminister Rubio spricht zunächst von der Beteiligung eines "ausländischen Akteurs". Jetzt wird der britische Premier Burnham konkreter.

items.title: Ukraine's Air Force comments on delay of air-raid warning in Kyiv
items.teaser: Yurii Ihnat has stated Ukrainian and allied intelligence will examine why early launch data was missing before Russian ballistic missiles targeted Kyiv.

items.title: Russian attacks damage cargo terminal and warehouses in Mykolaiv region
items.teaser: Russian strikes damaged a cargo terminal and warehouses in the Mykolaiv region.

items.title: European Aquatics president visits Russia and discusses possibility of holding competitions there
items.teaser: António Silva, the president of European Aquatics, the governing body for aquatic sports in Europe, has visited Russia at the invitation of Dmitry Mazepin, head of the Russian Aquatics Federation, and assessed the possibility of holding international competitions there.

items.title: Sabotage in Polen: Zwei Verdächtige in Deutschland gefasst
items.teaser: Am 23.

items.title: Serbia accredits Russian diplomat expelled from Bulgaria over spying scandal
items.teaser: Russian diplomat Alexander Krasiy, who was expelled from Bulgaria during an arms depot explosion investigation, has been accredited as an assistant military attaché in Serbia.

items.title: War update: 202 combat engagements on front line over past day
items.teaser: On October 12, Ukraine's Defense Forces recorded 202 combat engagements with Russian forces along the front line.

items.title: Luftwaffe: 88 russische Drohnen unschädlich gemacht
items.teaser: Die ukrainischen Luftstreitkräfte haben ihren eigenen Angaben zufolge 88 Drohnen, mit denen Russland die Ukraine in der Nacht auf den 13. Oktober. angegriffen hat, abgewehrt.

items.title: Woman injured and house damaged in Kyiv's Darnytskyi district in Russian attack
items.teaser: A woman has been injured when debris from a drone damaged a house and its garden fence in eastern Kyiv on the morning of 13 October. Emergency services were dispatched to the scene, with no casualties mentioned in the initial reports.

items.title: ADF neutralizes 88 Russian drones used to attack Ukraine overnight
items.teaser: Ukraine's air defense forces neutralized 88 drones used by Russian forces to attack the country from the evening of October 12.

items.title: Raketenangriff auf Charkiw: drei Menschen tot aus den Trümmern geborgen, 10 weitere verletzt
items.teaser: Im Cholodnohirskyj Bezirk von Charkiw sind Leichen von drei Personen aus den Trümmern eines Hauses, das von einer russischen Rakete getroffen wurde, geborgen, teilt der Bürgermeister der Stadt Ihor Terechow auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Poll: 47% of EU citizens support Ukraine joining the union quickly
items.teaser: A Bertelsmann Foundation poll of 16,795 people across the EU found that support for Ukraine joining the bloc in the coming years varies widely between member states, with Sweden and Romania at opposite ends of the results.

items.title: Polen: Festnahmen in Deutschland nach Brand an Starlink-Station
items.teaser: Nach dem Brand an einer Starlink-Station in Polen gibt es Festnahmen in Deutschland. Polens Regierung vermutet Russland hinter der Sabotageaktion.

items.title: Russian drone attack at medical facility in Khmelnytskyi region leaves four patients injured
items.teaser: Four patients at a medical facility in Khmelnytskyi region were injured in a Russian drone attack.

items.title: Russians attacked on seven fronts, 29 times on Pokrovsk front - Ukraine's General Staff
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff has reported 203 combat clashes over 24 hours, with heavy Russian assault operations concentrated on the Pokrovsk and Slobozhanshchyna fronts.

items.title: Drone debris falls on private property in Kyiv's Darnytskyi district
items.teaser: Debris from a Russian drone fell on the grounds of a private residential property in Kyiv's Darnytskyi district.

items.title: Russia attacks Ukraine with ballistic missiles, Banderol drone missiles and 108 drones: air defences downs 88 UAVs
items.teaser: Russia launched five ballistic missiles, nine drone missiles and 108 drones from the evening of 12 October. Ukrainian air defences reported impacts at 17 locations and fallen debris at seven others.

items.title: Tusk: Zwei mutmaßliche Saboteure in Deutschland festgenommen
items.teaser: Am 23.

items.title: Russian attack damages medical facility in Khmelnytskyi Oblast, injuring four patients
items.teaser: Russian drone attacks on 12 October damaged windows and the entrance to a healthcare facility as well as nearby parked cars. Four patients receiving treatment sustained minor injuries.

items.title: Russia loses another 1,390 troops in one day in war against Ukraine.
items.teaser: Russia’s total estimated combat losses since the start of its full-scale invasion of Ukraine on February 24, 2022, reached approximately 1,555,700 personnel as of October 13, 2026, including 1,390 over the past 24 hours.

items.title: Zelenskyy says Germany is organising a meeting of Coalition of the Willing
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and Chancellor Friedrich Merz have agreed to coordinate security meetings as Russia continues targeting Ukraine's power grid.

items.title: Because I said so: Trump explains why he believes Ukraine and Russia agreed to "energy ceasefire"
items.teaser: Asked about Russian strikes, US President Donald Trump said he would need to check whether the ceasefire had been violated, adding that both sides had breached it.

items.title: Drone attack damages houses and cars in Lviv region
items.teaser: Two houses caught fire after a downed Russian drone crashed into a residential building in a village in the Lviv region.
